# Join our brand new lab at NTU!

Launching QMagSpin Lab at NTU EEE in Fall 2026. We are looking for motivated students and postdocs who are excited by quantum materials, experimental physics, and the challenge of creating new ways to probe and control magnons and collective quantum excitations.
:::

## PhD students

We have openings for Jan 2027 intake! 

Prospective PhD students interested in magnonics, spintronics and heterostructure engineering of quantum excitations are welcome. Various [scholarships](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/eee/admissions/programmes/graduate-programmes/awards--scholarships-and-teaching-opportunities-(for-postgradute-ph.d.)#Content_C041_Col00), including the prestigious Nanyang President's Graduate scholarship and the Provost Graduate Award are available.

## Postdoctoral researchers

We welcome prospective postdocs interested in research at the intersection of ultrafast spectroscopy, terahertz science, spintronics, and low-dimensional quantum materials.

## Undergraduate researchers

NTU undergraduate students interested in research projects, URECA, final-year projects, or shorter research experiences are welcome to contact us.
